description: This file defines a React component 'NewChat' that handles the UI for creating a new chat, including mask selection, layout, and navigation logic. It includes sub-components such as 'MaskItem' and hooks like 'useMaskGroup'.

classes.name: MaskItem
classes.description: A functional component that displays a single mask with avatar and name, handling click events.

classes.name: NewChat
classes.description: Main React component for the New Chat interface, managing layout, interactions, and state for starting new chat sessions with masks.

methods.name: useMaskGroup
methods.description: Custom hook that computes grouping of masks based on container size for layout purposes.

methods.name: startChat
methods.description: Function to initiate a new chat session, optionally with a selected mask, and navigate to chat page.
